title: lindsaea lancea var. elatior
intro: Lindsaea lancea var. elatior, commonly known as the Elatior Lindsaea Fern, is a species of fern in the family Lindsaeaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. It is also valued for its therapeutic actions, such as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Lindsaea lancea var. elatior include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
